text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, March 3 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant, 4 vessels due by 17/3, no delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Two vessels loading, 14 due by 18/3, no delays.
Hay Point - One vessel loading, 13 due by 30/3, no delays.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - Shiploader No. 1 (No. 2 berth) will be shut down for repairs to sample plant from 07.00 hrs. 4/3 until 19.00 hrs. 5/3. One vessel loading, 19 due by 5/4, no delays.
Barney Point - Berth vacant, 3 vessels due by 15/3, no delays.
Brisbane - One vessel loading, 4 due by 12/3, no delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 7 waiting, 15 due by 18/3, approx. 5-6 days delay expected.
Channel (dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 5 waiting, 13 due by 14/3, approx. 4-5 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - Vessels arriving 7-10/3 berthing out of turn due to cargo not being available at stockpile. One vessel loading, 14 due by 20/4.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Shippers advise that, due to current shortage of Yandi fines and Mt. Newman fines, iron ore vessels may experience some delays to berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 4 anchored, 6 due by 15/3. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 5 due by 12/3, 9 others due by 25/3, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - Shippers advise that due to current shortage of fines, iron ore vessels may experience some berthing/loading delays. One vessel loading, 1 due 8/3.
Dampier - Parker Point - Dredging operations completed 13.00 hrs. 3/3. Six vessels anchored.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 1 due 9/3, dredging operations from 14.00 hrs. 3/3 to 15.00 hrs. 5/3.
Dampier line-up - 3 Vessels anchored (1 for Parker Point, 2 for East Intercourse island), 20 due by 28/3 (10 for East Intercourse island, 10 for Parker Point).
Port Walcott - One vessel loading, 1 anchored, 15 due by 31/3.
